name: MCP Server & Tools
description: The stdio MCP server entry point and the tool handlers it registers for recording lifecycle, browser actions, and session setup, which orchestrate everything below them.

name: Browser & Capture
description: The logged-in headless Playwright browser, the recording session state, screencast capture with heartbeat frames, on-page emphasis overlays, TOTP login support, and profile/session import.

name: Media Production
description: Turns captured footage into the finished tutorial: ElevenLabs narration, word-level caption alignment, HeyGen avatar, generated music, HyperFrames motion cards, camera zoom, and the ffmpeg compositing pipeline.

name: Foundation Utilities
description: Environment/configuration loading and the shared logger, imported by nearly every other module in the server.

name: Motion Assets
description: Brand stylesheet and GSAP/HyperFrames HTML templates for the opening, chapter, and closing cards, plus the music chapter definitions used when splitting background tracks.

name: CLI & Operator Scripts
description: Command-line entry points for operators: the doctor environment check, interactive browser login, and scripts that record from an example script, recompose a finished run, or split music tracks.

name: Test & Smoke Scripts
description: End-to-end pipeline run, JSON-RPC handshake smoke test, and live MCP run that exercise the server and its video pipeline.

name: Configuration & Examples
description: npm package and TypeScript build configuration, plus example tutorial scripts that drive the recording and action tools.

name: Documentation
description: README setup guide, architecture and design decisions for the capture/compose pipeline, and the project's plan and status logs.
